product_overview: NumHunt 2.0 is an atmospheric 3D archery-themed number guessing game with multiple play modes. Players can train solo, compete in pass-and-play tournaments, or challenge a friend in a head-to-head duel, all with visual trajectory feedback and optional sound effects.
core_goals: Choose a game mode and start playing immediately
Make guesses and use archery feedback to narrow down the secret number
Progress through solo training with limited attempts and increasing difficulty
Compete with multiple players in a local pass-and-play tournament
Challenge another player in an alternating-turn duel
Toggle game sounds on or off during play

features.name: Game Mode Selection
features.description: Let players choose between solo training, tournament play, and head-to-head duel from the main interface.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select the Single Player mode -> Enter solo gameplay
Navigate to / -> Select the Tournament mode -> Enter tournament setup
Navigate to / -> Select the Head-to-Head Duel mode -> Enter duel setup

features.name: Single Player Mode
features.description: Allow one player to guess a hidden number with two difficulty levels, limited attempts, and 3D archery-style feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select the Single Player mode -> Choose Level 1 -> Enter a numeric guess -> Submit the guess -> Observe the arrow impact and trajectory feedback -> Review remaining attempts -> Continue guessing until the number is found or attempts run out

Navigate to / -> Select the Single Player mode -> Choose Level 2 -> Enter a numeric guess -> Submit the guess -> Observe the arrow impact and trajectory feedback -> See the extreme hint when the guess is far from the target -> Review remaining attempts -> Continue guessing until the number is found or attempts run out
Navigate to / -> Select the Single Player mode -> Start a game -> Complete the round -> Restart the game -> Begin a new solo session

features.name: Tournament Mode
features.description: Support a local pass-and-play tournament for 2 to 4 players with private handovers, sequential rounds, and a final leaderboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select the Tournament mode -> Choose the number of players -> Enter each player name -> Start the tournament -> Read the private handover screen -> Mark readiness to begin the round -> Enter a guess for the current player -> Submit the guess -> Observe trajectory feedback -> Hand the device to the next player -> Continue until all rounds are complete -> View the final leaderboard and winners podium
Navigate to / -> Select the Tournament mode -> Choose the number of players -> Enter player names -> Start the tournament -> Complete the final round -> View the crowned winners and podium results

features.name: Head-to-Head Duel Mode
features.description: Let two players set secret numbers, then alternate turns guessing each other's number until one player wins.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select the Head-to-Head Duel mode -> Enter Player 1 secret number -> Enter Player 2 secret number -> Commence the duel -> Take alternating turns entering guesses -> Submit a guess -> Observe trajectory feedback -> Continue alternating turns until one player guesses correctly -> Reveal both secret numbers and see the winner

Navigate to / -> Select the Head-to-Head Duel mode -> Enter valid secret numbers for both players -> Commence the duel -> Alternate guesses between players -> Win the match on the first correct guess -> Review the result

features.name: Audio Effects Control
features.description: Allow players to mute or unmute procedural archery sound effects from the main interface, with the setting remembered locally.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the audio setting -> Observe sound effects turn on or off
Navigate to / -> Toggle the audio setting -> Leave the page and return later -> Observe the audio setting remains unchanged

routes.description: NumHunt 2.0 Main Tactical Archery Interface (Mode Select, Single Player, Tournament, Duel)

features.name: Game Mode Selection
features.description: Select between Single Player training, Multiplayer Tournament, and Head-to-Head Duel
user_interactions: Click "Single Player" card to navigate to single player mode
Click "Tournament" card to navigate to tournament setup
Click "Head-to-Head Duel" card to navigate to duel setup

features.name: Single Player Mode
features.description: Play solo number guessing with 3D archery feedback, attempt counters, and trajectory telemetry
user_interactions: Toggle Level 1 (1-100, 10 attempts) or Level 2 (1-1000, 15 attempts)
Enter numerical guess in input box
Click FIRE ARROW or press Enter
Observe 3D arrow trajectory (bullseye for correct, ground for lower, over-target for higher)
View remaining attempts and telemetry log after arrow impact
Trigger and read Level 2 Extreme Hint when difference exceeds 500
Click Restart to start a new single player game

features.name: Tournament Mode
features.description: 2-4 player sequential archery tournament with private handovers and attempt scoring
user_interactions: Select number of players (2 to 4)
Enter custom player names
Click Start Tournament
View private handover screen and click Ready to start player round
Submit guesses with 3D archery feedback
Handover device to next player upon round completion
View final tournament leaderboard podium and crowned winners

features.name: Head-to-Head Duel Mode
features.description: 2-player pass-and-play duel guessing opponent secret number with alternating turns
user_interactions: Enter Player 1 secret number (1-100) via password field
Enter Player 2 secret number (1-100) via password field
Click Commence Duel
Alternate turns guessing opponent secret
Submit guesses and observe 3D trajectory feedback
Win match on first correct guess and reveal both secret numbers

features.name: Audio Effects Control
features.description: Toggle procedural Web Audio API archery sound effects
user_interactions: Click audio toggle button in header to mute/unmute sounds
Sound settings persist in localStorage

known_limitations.impact: Multiplayer requires sharing the same physical screen/device, no remote networking
